textbookBox.concept: In India neem was given Sanskrit names such as Arishta, which means one who cures diseases, along with Nimba and Nimbaca. The name Neem was given by the Iranians. In Hindi it is Nimb.

beats.en: Neem twigs are used to clean teeth, and the leaves protect clothes. When someone has measles, doctors suggest putting neem leaves on the bed. Neem leaves have chemical properties that destroy germs.
